Download the PHW logo

Source: R/logo.R
phw_download_logos.Rd

Downloads the official bilingual logo (SVG) from phw.nhs.wales. It then makes blue, white and black versions in SVG and PNG, and stores them in your user cache folder (see tools::R_user_dir()). You only need to do this once per computer. It isn't needed if you set options(phwstyle.logo_dir = ...) to a folder with your own copies.

Usage

phw_download_logos(ask = interactive(), url = logo_url)

Arguments

ask

Ask before downloading? Always TRUE in interactive sessions unless you set it to FALSE.

url

Where to download the white SVG logo from.

Value

The cache folder, invisibly, or NULL if nothing was downloaded.

Details

The logo is a trade mark of Public Health Wales. Use it only in line with PHW's brand guidance.

Examples

# \donttest{
# Run once per computer. It asks before downloading anything.
if (interactive()) phw_download_logos()
# }
